import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,re
lane=Path.cwd();res=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text());results=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());assert set(map(int,results))==set(res['ids']) and len(results)==20
bindings=json.loads(Path('original-bindings.json').read_text());assert len(bindings)==20
chunks={};ids=[]
for b in bindings:
 p=Path(b['chunk'])
 if str(p) not in chunks:chunks[str(p)]=p.read_bytes()
 data=chunks[str(p)];assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==b['chunk_sha256'];raw=data.splitlines(keepends=True)[b['line']-1];assert raw.decode()==b['raw'];assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==b['raw_sha256'];assert raw.endswith(b'\n')==b['newline']
 o=json.loads(raw);ids.append(o['mathdb_id']);assert json.loads(b['statement_token'])==o['statement']==b['statement_utf8'];assert hashlib.sha256(b['statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==b['statement_token_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==b['statement_utf8_sha256']
assert set(ids)==set(res['ids'])
hist=json.loads(Path('history-access.json').read_text());flagged=[r['path'] for r in hist if any(any(t in part.lower() for t in ['formal','code-loop','polynexus','crown','bunkbed','tournament','hat-','expanded-corpus-r395','expanded-corpus-r463','expanded-corpus-r466','expanded-corpus-r482','high-girth-ur-matching-formal-sol-r5','parking-strong-a2-source-review-sol-r1']) for part in Path(r['path']).parts)];assert not flagged
prev='0'*64;records=[]
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 o=json.loads(raw);assert o['seq']==len(records) and o['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest();records.append(o)
attempts=[r for r in records if r['event']=='attempt'];assert len(attempts)==5 and all(r['url'].startswith('https://') for r in attempts)
charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==2;assert budget['queries_used']==sum(len(c['queries']) for c in charges)==6
for i,c in enumerate(charges,1):
 assert c['sequence']==i;assert hashlib.sha256(Path(c['plan']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c['plan_sha256'];response=json.loads(Path(f'search-response{i}.json').read_text());assert isinstance(response,str) and len(response)>1000
assert all(results[str(i)]['credit']==0 and not results[str(i)]['formal_dispatch'] for i in ids)
out={'exact20_bindings_verified':True,'raw_token_decoded_verified':20,'history_access_names_checked':len(hist),'protected_names_in_saved_access':flagged,'guard_hashchain_verified_rows':len(records),'HTTPS_attempts':len(attempts),'PDF_successes':sum(r['event']=='success' for r in records),'native_search_calls':2,'native_querystrings':6,'full_actual_responses_present':True,'author_proof_independently_reviewed':False,'credit':0,'limits':'Documentary verification only, no mathematical or universal process PASS. Seal terminal self-exclusions must be explicit.'}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'FINAL-DOCUMENTARY-VALIDATION.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,check=True);print(json.dumps(out))
